meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导你把第一个 NanoClaw agent 接到某个私信频道:先确认你的频道身份,再选定或新建 agent,最后通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信以验证送达。整段流程可重复运行,重跑是安全的。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置好、且服务正在运行时使用,用来给一个已安装的频道接上第一个 agent。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 NanoClaw agent,给 Discord 发欢迎私信
say.note: 会先问你的频道用户 ID、显示名和 agent 名

say.text: 重新跑一次初始化,agent 名换成 XiaoMing
say.note: 可重复运行,同名会复用已有 agent 组

howto.what_en: Guides you through setting up the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: resolve your channel identity, select or create the agent, and send a welcome DM through the normal delivery path to verify delivery. Reruns are safe (idempotent).
howto.when_en: Use after the channel credentials are configured and the service is running, to wire the first agent to an installed channel.

say_en.text: Set up my first NanoClaw agent and send a welcome DM on Discord
say_en.note: It asks for your channel user ID, display name, agent name

say_en.text: Initialize the agent for Telegram; my Telegram user ID is ...
say_en.note: It reads the channel skill for how to find your ID

say_en.text: Rerun the init with the agent name XiaoMing
say_en.note: Reruns are safe; same name reuses the group
